source_refs.title: Make text and apps bigger
source_refs.section: Make text bigger on your screen
source_refs.applicability: Windows 11; the page gives these steps for text that feels too small while navigating Windows
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If the text size feels too small when navigating through Windows, you can make the text bigger.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Windows 11: If the text size feels too small when navigating through Windows, you can make the text bigger. Press the Windows logo key+U, or select Start, then Settings, then Accessibility. Select 'Text size'. Drag the 'Text size' slider to the right to enlarge the sample text. Select 'Apply'. Windows then scales up all text.

source_refs.title: Make text and apps bigger
source_refs.section: Make images and apps bigger on your screen
source_refs.applicability: Windows 11; some changes may require signing out and back in before they appear in certain apps; most changes apply right away
source_refs.verified_excerpt: In addition to the text size, you can also make everything else on your screen bigger, including images and apps.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Windows 11: Open Settings with the Windows key + I shortcut, or from Start. Select 'Display'. Under 'Scale & layout', expand the 'Scale' menu and choose the percentage you want. Some changes may require signing out and back in before they appear in certain apps. Most changes apply right away.
